title: Routing
intro: What goes through the VPN and what goes around it. These settings apply in INCY.
unavailable: Could not load your routing settings. Check your connection and try again.

ruDirect.label: Russian sites — direct
ruDirect.hint: Banks, Gosuslugi, marketplaces and sites on .ru, .su and .рф open without the VPN, from your usual address — no need to switch the VPN off for them.

blockAds.label: Block ads
blockAds.hint: Cuts ads and trackers, by our list and through AdGuard DNS. Now and then it breaks a site that will not load without its ads.

note: INCY applies these on its next subscription refresh — refresh the subscription in the app to apply them now. The site lists weigh under a megabyte and update themselves. In Hiddify, v2rayNG, Streisand and other apps these switches do nothing: they have their own “Russia direct” setting.
